reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I liked the app and resolved to using it more but logged in to find the entries I had made previously are gone.

reviews.title: Virus prone
reviews.text: Virus on the app. Be careful.

reviews.title: Intolerable advertising
reviews.text: Made first entry successfully, but when save button pressed a full screen video advert started playing. Infuriated, I deleted the app immediately.

reviews.title: Diary - journal with password
reviews.text: I like this app but when you do loads of diaries day by day that somehow disappear without you deleting them, it's annoying when you message people for months for help and no answer back from them at all to help.
